Sour gas is first obtained by [[vacuum refining|Vacuum Refinery]] [[pressurized|Compressor]] [[crude oil|Crude Oil]]. It is used in a variety of applications including the production of [[TATB]], and the [[conversion|Ore Acidizer]] of [[latex|Latex]] to [[rubber|Rubber]]. It may also be obtained by [[hydrotreating|Hydrotreater]] various [[oil|Crude Oil]] and [[diesel|Cracked Diesel]] variants.
